title.zh: Stripe联创：收购Privy后其收入增至此前约9倍，钱包资产规模增至约25倍
title.en: Stripe联创：收购Privy后其收入增至此前约9倍，钱包资产规模增至约25倍

current_state.zh: Stripe 正将 Privy 集成至 Treasury、Link 与 Connect，并构建统一 API 用于持有稳定币余额并赚取收益、法币进出以及通过卡片协调消费；Link 余额即将推出。
current_state.en: Stripe is integrating Privy into Treasury, Link and Connect, and building a unified API for holding yield-bearing stablecoin balances, fiat on/off-ramps and card-coordinated spending; Link balances are launching soon.

updates.title_zh: Stripe联创：收购Privy后其收入增至此前约9倍，钱包资产规模增至约25倍
updates.title_en: Stripe联创：收购Privy后其收入增至此前约9倍，钱包资产规模增至约25倍
updates.what_changed_zh: Stripe联合创始人Patrick Collison表示，自收购以来，Privy的钱包资产增长了约25倍，月活跃开发者增长约3倍，收入增长约9倍；Stripe目前正将Privy深度整合进Treasury、Link和Connect，并构建统一API，用于稳定币余额、收益、法币出入金、卡片消费和AI代理交易，每月处理近250亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Stripe co-founder Patrick Collison said Privy's wallet assets have grown ~25x, monthly active developers ~3x, and revenue ~9x since acquisition, with Stripe now deeply integrating Privy into Treasury, Link and Connect and building a unified API for stablecoin balances, yield, fiat on/off-ramps, card spending and AI-agent transactions processing nearly $25B monthly.
